title: Oath of the Gatewatch: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane under Eldrazi assault, beautiful despite devastation.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Vast beings of Kozilek's and Ulamog's broods that overrun Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who emerged at Sea Gate and destroyed it.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who stood before the defenders at Sea Gate before Kozilek arose.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A city that fell to the Eldrazi, once a center for knowledge.

entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker who warns of the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, deadly to those without the spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who calls the Gatewatch and discovers the leyline pattern anchoring titans.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights beside the Zendikari and keeps the brood lineages at bay.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker whose heart beats with Zendikar's.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who incinerates the bound Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who suffered on Zendikar and was caught off guard by Chandra.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The oath-sworn group of planeswalkers who keep watch.

entities.name: Zarra
entities.description: A lullmage.

entities.name: Nazra of the Stone Havens
entities.description: A Stone Havens speaker on light.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: A figure whose light is followed into battle.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: An ambush leader.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: High priest of the Eternal Pilgrims.

entities.name: Trinda
entities.description: A Hada spy patrol member.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem roilmage.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist.

entities.name: Vandri
entities.description: Kalastria emissary who witnessed Sea Gate.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Thrall of Ulamog.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A Kalastria bloodchief who commands nulls.

entities.name: General Tazri
entities.description: An allied commander.

entities.name: Tarek
entities.description: A man who could not tell if he lost blood or mind.

entities.name: Tobin
entities.description: A sparkmage.

entities.name: Zada of Slab Haven
entities.description: A goblin commando leader.

entities.name: Valakut
entities.description: A volcano that grieved when Sea Gate was destroyed.

entities.name: Greenweaver Mina
entities.description: Leader with her twin brother Denn of the last of the Mul Daya.

entities.name: Denn
entities.description: Mina's twin brother.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: People led by Mina and Denn.

entities.name: Raff Slugeater
entities.description: A goblin shortcutter.

entities.name: Harak
entities.description: A Malakir bloodwitch.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A relic hunter and ruin diver.

entities.name: Ryza
entities.description: An Oran-Rief scout.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of the sea's mysteries.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stones that bind Eldrazi when aligned and remained intact in devastation.

entities.name: Halimar basin
entities.description: A basin drained after Sea Gate fell.

events.summary: Kozilek emerges at Sea Gate and his brood swarms to the surface.
events.quote: When Kozilek emerged at Sea Gate, his brood lineage swarmed to the surface.

events.summary: Kozilek destroys Sea Gate and Valakut grieves.
events.quote: When Kozilek destroyed Sea Gate, distant Valakut could not contain its grief.

events.summary: Ulamog stands ready to succumb at Sea Gate, then Kozilek arises.
events.quote: Ulamog stood before us at Sea Gate, ready to succumb . . . and then Kozilek arose.

events.summary: Sea Gate falls and the Halimar basin is drained.
events.quote: After the fall of Sea Gate and the draining of the Halimar basin, the crab set off to find a new home.

events.summary: Jace and Gideon call planeswalkers to stay and fight, founding the Gatewatch.
events.quote: But Gideon's right: we're also the ones who can choose to stay.

events.summary: Jace discovers the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek, which Nissa traces on her world.
events.quote: Jace discovered the leyline pattern needed to anchor Ulamog and Kozilek to reality, but it was Nissa who could trace it on her world.

events.summary: Gideon and Nissa carve a path through the Eldrazi swarm.
events.quote: Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.

events.summary: Gideon holds back the brood lineages while Chandra incinerates the bound titans.
events.quote: As Gideon kept the brood lineages at bay, Chandra incinerated the bound Eldrazi titans.

events.summary: Chandra lures hellions into the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Chandra used jets of flame to lure hellions into the path of oncoming Eldrazi.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis is surprised by Chandra.
events.quote: Ob Nixilis had prepared for every eventuality—except Chandra Nalaar.

events.summary: Jace asks himself what Gideon would say to inspire an army.
events.quote: Faced with the novel problem of inspiring an army, Jace asked himself: "What would Gideon say?"

events.summary: The Gatewatch members swear their oaths to keep watch.
events.quote: For justice and peace, I will keep watch.

events.summary: Oath near ruins of Sea Gate is witnessed.
events.quote: Before the battle, I heard them take an oath near the ruins of Sea Gate.

relations.quote: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.

relations.note: Mina and Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya.
relations.quote: Greenweaver Mina and her twin brother Denn lead the last of the Mul Daya into an uncertain future.
When Kozilek destroyed Sea Gate, distant Valakut could not contain its grief.
But Gideon's right: we're also the ones who can choose to stay.
Gideon and Nissa carved a path through the Eldrazi swarm, and their Zendikari allies charged into the fray behind them.
